Application Data.NAME: The Grand Historical Library
Application Data.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Head of Collections, (555) 123-4567, john.smith@grandhistorical.org
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: The Grand Historical Library is a community-oriented institution dedicated to preserving, exhibiting, and providing access to a diverse range of historical artifacts, rare books, and fine art collections. We actively engage in educational programs, workshops, and public events to promote literacy and cultural awareness. Our facility includes exhibition spaces, reading rooms, and event venues, where we host lectures, book signings, and community gatherings. All fine art and valuable collections are professionally appraised every three years to ensure proper valuation and insurability. We maintain rigorous safety and security protocols to protect our collections, and we do not permit the use of drones on our premises. Alcohol service will be limited to select events with appropriate licensed vendors and security measures in place.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses incurred include water damage to the rare book collection on 04/15/2022, caused by a plumbing failure, amounting to $10,000; the status is resolved with repairs completed. Additionally, on 08/10/2022, a theft incident involved five valuable artifacts, leading to a loss of $5,000; the claim is currently under investigation by local authorities.

with alcohol service or bar operations triggers enhanced scrutiny of liquor liability controls,
including licensed bartenders, security presence, and guest capacity limits.
